management_steps.details: ABCD survey. Establish large-bore IVs. Administer 30ml/kg balanced crystalloid bolus (Ringer's Lactate/Balsol) for hypotension or Lactate > 4.
Measure Lactate. Obtain blood cultures PRIOR to antibiotics (aerobic bottle ONLY, minimum 10ml, preferably 20ml). Administer broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour.
If persistent hypotension despite fluids: start Adrenaline/Noradrenaline infusion to maintain MAP >= 65 mmHg. Re-measure lactate if initial lactate was high.

warnings: Blood cultures must always be taken BEFORE the first dose of antibiotics.
Be extremely cautious with aggressive fluids in patients with cardiac dysfunction or elderly (risk of acute pulmonary edema).
